title.narrative: Rising Strong: Building a brighter and peaceful tomorrow for earthquake-affected children in Northwest Syria

description.narrative:
This proposal outlines War Child's aim to provide sustained assistance to 10,860 children and their caregivers who have been severely impacted by the recent earthquake in Northwest Syria. The proposed intervention will be a comprehensive project focusing on Child Protection, Psychosocial Support, and Education, with a particular emphasis on addressing the medium- and long-term effects of the disaster. The project will be implemented in the affected areas of Idleb and Aleppo Governorates, which have been heavily impacted by the earthquake.


The Action will be implemented for 18 months from July 2023 ¿ December 2024 and will contribute to the overall objective of promoting peacebuilding, stabilization, and social cohesion by enhancing the resilience and wellbeing of children, youth and caregivers affected by the earthquake in two of the hardest hit Governorate of NWS: Idleb and Aleppo
